Players Committee card image of [[Boba Fett (V) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Deploys -1 aboard Slave 1. Adds one battle destiny with Vader (or while piloting Slave 1). Once per game, if a battle was just initiated here, may exchange a card in hand with a card in Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual6-Dark/large/bobafett.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/eb9f1e88dd679e4fa7860bc7cc8b6032d3476e13 eb9f1e8] (22 April 2024). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the latest version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
